about_short_description.short_description: AccioJob provides a campus placement and training platform for software development jobs.

identifier.value: Full Stack Development Courses with Gen AI

product.name: Full Stack Development Courses with Gen AI
product.description: Training programs in full stack web development using Java or MERN stack, incorporating generative AI concepts, designed to build coding and software development skills.

product.name: Data Analytics Course
product.description: A training program focused on data analytics skills including Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Python, aimed at preparing learners for data analyst roles.

product.name: Data Science & AI Course
product.description: An educational program teaching data science and artificial intelligence concepts, including machine learning and generative AI, to prepare learners for roles in data science and AI.

product.name: Hiring Drives and Placement Assistance
product.description: Organized hiring events and placement support services connecting trained candidates with partner companies for software development and data roles.

product.name: Offline Skill Centres
product.description: Physical learning centers located in Pune, Noida, and Hyderabad offering face-to-face training and hiring drives for tech courses.
